title: ARC Raiders
provenance: Reported by VaSiLoNG (highball#291, 2026-10-08), Apple M1, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.10. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: An online game with Easy Anti-Cheat. Easy Anti-Cheat runs under Proton on Linux when a game allows it, but that support does not carry over to Wine on a Mac, so the game is not expected to get past its anti-cheat through Highball. The report did not say where it stopped.

knownIssues.symptom: The game does not start (reported on an M1, macOS 27.0.1)
knownIssues.cause: most likely Easy Anti-Cheat, which has no Mac Wine support
